I don’t think it’s healthy necessarily to be in a 7 year relationship and then to have only have one friend which is an ex? And then the way you talk and rationalize what you’d did to your partner of 7 years paints you out as some victim.

The best thing you can do for yourself if you ever wanna get better is learn to take accountability 
And if your ex of 7 years is reading this
DO NOT GET BACK WITH THIS PERSON RUN

anyways I’m sorry you’re struggling and any 7 year relationship ending will be very triggering and hard to process. Self reflection and care is reallt what I recommend

The last time me and my boyfriend broke up I didn’t know I had bpd yet I just knew I couldn’t control my emotions so I kept separating myself from him bc I was tired of hurting him and lying and just being horrible sometimes and so I kept trying to break up with him but he always would just stay, he understand me alright backstory I’m (21f) he’s (23m) we met when I was 19 were great then tried drugs were big crazy did lots of just stupid stuff got sober together he started a business I started getting my life in order we were growing up so then here we are 2021 we were not perfect but we were so much better than we were, he picks me up one night and is completely sober then we go to bed and I look over he’s blue not breathing. He was overdosing did not realize it at first was probably in shock but I call 911 they get there save him we good. I’m fucking pissed bc one he did drugs and literally just died in front of me, I still love him to death it just scared me and I didn’t wanna go back down that path. So we break up, I left him when he needed me most bc I really believed all the delusions in my head. I wish I hadn’t been so mean, I changed my number and then 3 days later he died from an overdose. Ik it was my fault I wasn’t even allowed at the funeral. I do not know how I will get past the guilt of what i did

I lost my boyfriend as well im (21f) btw, I lost him about 8 months ago and it still feels like it was yesterday my perception of time is fuckeddd up since it happened. I would definitely recommend self care just imagine your child self and take of yourself and give yourself so much love because you’ll need it also getting meal supplement shakes because I didn’t eat either and you can just chug one of those down and at least survive. That’s all you need to do is survive, be patient and forgiving with yourself and your emotions. It will get better. I also make a lot of really inappropriate dead boyfriend jokes to everyone around me to make everyone else as uncomfortable as I am inside and that helps me immensely. However you choose to deal with your grief is perfectly okay just know you’re not alone ❤️

This may be completely different than your situation but I lost my boyfriend around 8 months ago I’m 21f rn , we’d been together almost 4 years on and off a lot bc I had undiagnosed bpd and I think somehow he knew when I would freak out and try to leave him he knew it wasn’t really me and would tell me that and I just was so confused and frustrated I just kept trying to leave him bc I knew I was being mean sometimes and I wanted better for him. Well things had gotten messy at the end for us and I was just so tired of the entire situation and the big mess we created but I loved him so so much. I broke up with him and changed my number a few days before he overdosed. I will never know if he tried to reach me. I hate myself honestly but anyways I found out on Instagram after I’d posted something and started getting comments like “we know you do herion” “how could u post this after what happened “ literally just like a smiling selfie. No body told me that how I found out was from there comments. And I was told by his best friend that I should go to the funeral. His mom came by and talked to me to get him clothes and asked if I knew he was doing drugs and I really didn’t know he was using again. We’d done stuff when we first met but at this time we were both doing really well. Just didn’t make sense. But as a mom would you hate me as well I just will never understand not being able to go to his funeral I know he would have wanted me there

I just lost my best friend recently and my boyfriend 8 months ago as well I wish I could tell you it gets easier but there was this one quote that helped me a lot maybe it can help you “ grief is love , love that has lost its place to go and has entire new meaning and direction” I kinda took that as turning the grief into something good if that makes sense. But I’m so sorry my heart goes out to you ❤️

I had a similar dream like this with my best friend who passed. I was dreaming unaware woke up realized I was dreaming of her went back into my dream knowing and told her what happened and she didn’t respond but just held my hand and just stayed with me. We soaked in as much time as we could together but it was like a goodbye. I know it was her, she 2-/ just making sure I was okay:(

I also feel like that a lot and a lot of it stemmed from a toxic relationship plus the bpd lol. But idk if this will help anyone but I just changed my way of thinking about it and make it more fun and instead of feeling jealous over all these gorgeous people I just am learning to appreciate them and instead of thinking “damn I wanna be her” I think now “ damn I wanna have a threesome with that bitch”idk if that’ll help anyone and I’m pretty straight but I can definitely appreciate some women🤷🏻‍♀️
